missing-beta-parameters.error_identification: High RMSE and MAE values indicate poor model fit.
missing-beta-parameters.root_cause_analysis: The Calibrator.fit method has beta_f, beta_w, and beta_c parameters set to 0.0, which means the model is not considering the influence of neighbors.
missing-beta-parameters.correct_approach: Update the Calibrator.fit method to include beta_f, beta_w, and beta_c in the optimization process.
missing-beta-parameters.key_insight: Ensure all relevant parameters are included in the optimization process to improve model fit.

insufficient-random-search.error_identification: The random search process may not be sufficient to find the optimal parameters.
insufficient-random-search.root_cause_analysis: The current implementation of the random search process may not be thorough enough to explore the parameter space effectively.
insufficient-random-search.correct_approach: Increase the number of random trials and consider using a more efficient search algorithm.
insufficient-random-search.key_insight: A more thorough search process can help improve the quality of the calibrated parameters.

non-robust-nelder-mead-optimization.error_identification: The Nelder-Mead optimization process may not be robust to local minima.
non-robust-nelder-mead-optimization.root_cause_analysis: The Nelder-Mead optimization process can get stuck in local minima, which may not be the global optimum.
non-robust-nelder-mead-optimization.correct_approach: Consider using a more robust optimization algorithm, such as simulated annealing or genetic algorithms.
non-robust-nelder-mead-optimization.key_insight: Using a more robust optimization algorithm can help improve the quality of the calibrated parameters.
